install.//: The repo's pnpm workspace install, which the suite is a member of, plus the one browser the suite uses. Quartz Core installs separately (site:install).

e2e.//: Build every plugin of ours and the fixture site (twice: with and without them), then run the suite. Narrow it with --args, e.g. --args="../plugins/quartz-tags -g colour". See docs/adr/0004.
